product.title: Amsterdam Morning or Afternoon Small-Group Walking Tour

description.text: This small-group walking tour gives an insider's view of Amsterdam's historic center. A guide leads past Dam Square, the Royal Palace, Nieuwmarkt, and the Red Light District, with stories about UNESCO canals and 17th-century gabled houses. The morning or afternoon format keeps groups compact so commentary stays audible on busy streets. Walking logistics and landmark pacing stay with the guide so visitors can focus on the historic core rather than mapping a DIY circuit. Stops include Nieuwmarkt, Dam Square, Royal Palace Amsterdam, Kalverstraat.
